papers.title: Momentum in Large-Cap Equities: Does the Classic 12-1 Strategy Still Work?
papers.key_finding: S&P 500 12-1m momentum L/S: net -2.79% annualized, Sharpe -0.23. Long leg: +7.9% annualized. Short leg: catastrophic in 2009 and 2020 crashes. Long-only large-cap momentum works; L/S does not.

papers.title: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
papers.key_finding: 10 frontier LLMs evaluated on 183 instruments, 6 asset classes, 10 years. 90% fail to beat equal-weight. LLMs treat covariance as noise. Value is in constraint adaptation and tail-risk, not return optimization.

papers.title: Re-evaluating Short- and Long-Term Trend Factors in CTA Replication: A Bayesian Graphical Approach
papers.authors: Benhamou, Ohana, Etienne, Guez, Setrouk, Jacquot
papers.key_finding: Dynamically decomposes CTA returns into short-term trend, long-term trend, and market beta using Bayesian graphical model. Medium-term trend (6-12m) dominates risk-adjusted performance. Multiple horizons outperform single-horizon.
papers.reason_not_staged: H262 Bayesian barbell already documented. This provides academic confirmation but no new implementation path. The 'medium-term 125d redundant' finding from arXiv:2510.23150 remains the actionable constraint.

papers.title: SAE-FiRE: Sparse Autoencoder Feature Selection for Financial Document Representation
papers.key_finding: SAE decomposition of FinBERT dense representations + ANOVA feature selection significantly outperforms baseline FinBERT on earnings calls, 10Q reports, financial news. Reduces noise from pre-training redundancy.

papers.title: DeePM: Regime-Robust Deep Portfolio Management
papers.key_finding: Deep learning for systematic macro portfolio on 50 diversified futures. Net risk-adjusted returns ~2x conventional approaches, ~50% improvement over Momentum Transformer. Causal Sieve + Macroeconomic Graph Prior + Distributionally Robust Objective. Code: github.com/kieranjwood/deepm.

papers.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days
papers.key_finding: Multi-modal earnings prediction combining textual and numerical data. Previously reviewed in H317 assessment.
papers.reason_not_staged: H317 already NOT CONFIRMED. Underlying approach addressed.

papers.title: Retail Investor Horizon and Earnings Announcements
papers.key_finding: Long-horizon investor composition associated with pronounced PEAD — slow but persistent convergence toward fundamental value when patient capital is present.
papers.reason_not_staged: Signals that PEAD effect is structural (long-horizon institutions), not actionable as a new signal — H174 already captures the drift.

papers.title: Post-Earnings-Announcement Drift Prediction: Leveraging Post-event Investor Responses with Multi-task Learning
papers.key_finding: Multi-task learning with GradPerp adaptive task weighting for PEAD prediction. Incorporates post-event investor responses as auxiliary tasks.
papers.reason_not_staged: H375 already staged using GradPerp from XiaomoWu/PEAD repo. Same algorithm family — no new information.
